notes: THE FINDING. Kevin McHale '85 read rimprot 93 on 1.5 blocks a game, BLK% 2.4, DBPM -0.2 and NO 1985 All-Defensive selection — above Hakeem Olajuwon '85 (94 on BLK% 4.3) and 2 over his own '88 (91), the season he was a unanimous 1st-team pick. His BLK% 2.4 is 0.1 over 1985's p86, so recal_92's block evidence is 1.000 and the voted-band unlock is his WHOLE drep, 0.850 — which is his 1986 1st team decayed one year backwards. The same 2.2 in 1988 is p81 and unlocks 0.233. The vote the '85 card cashes was cast in 1986.

THE FIX IS recal_160's, APPLIED TO THE OTHER VOTE CHANNEL. recal_160 taught the rim REINFORCEMENT line (ID + 0.25*drep*hp) to read which season the ballot came from and pay a carried one at half rate. The voted-band UNLOCK (_w53) still read drep in full. It now reads own + rate*(drep - own), byte-identical for every card whose reputation is its own season's ballot — Mutombo '97, Duncan '03, Ben Wallace '04, Gobert '19, Wembanyama '24, Simmons '21 and McHale '86/'87/'88 all own 1.000 and do not move on their own season's score.

RESTORED BY THE SEASON'S OWN SHEET. A carried ballot that the card's own blocks AND DBPM independently certify is not carried evidence — the season says what the ballot says — so the rate returns to 1.000 through _measured_rim_evidence, recal_95's ceiling meter refactored out of _ceiling_evidence unchanged. That is what keeps Mutombo '00 (BLK% 5.9, DBPM +1.5) whole and with him the Mutombo '01 99 +-0 pin, and Noah '09 and Embiid '23 with theirs. McHale '85's DBPM is -0.2: nothing in 1985 backs the ballot.

THE RATE IS DERIVED, NOT FITTED: CARRIED_UNLOCK = 1 - (1 - CARRIED_REIN)/2 = 0.75. recal_160's discount, halved, because this gate is already multiplied by recal_92's block evidence and the reinforcement line is gated on nothing but height.

WHY 91 AND NOT 88 — STATED PLAINLY. Moses Malone '85 is the same 1985 sheet: BLK% 2.4, the same p87, 6'10", no 1985 ballot, drep 0.700 carried from 1983. The 76ers '85 defdial (recal_133, 93 +-2) reads 91 on main — EXACTLY on its floor — and it steps to 90 the moment Moses's rimprot goes 86 -> 85. So the carried rate cannot fall below ~0.67, and at any rate that keeps Moses at 86 the subject reads 91. Measured on the grid: 0.50 -> subject 90 / Moses 85 / dial FAIL; 0.60 -> 90 / 85 / FAIL; 0.65 -> 91 / 85 / FAIL; 0.70 -> 91 / 86 / all 160 pass; 0.75 -> 91 / 86 / all 160 pass; 0.80 -> 92 / 86 (subject out of band); 0.85 -> 92 / 86.

THE OTHER ROUTE WAS MEASURED AND REACHES THE IDENTICAL 91. Widening recal_92's block-evidence band (BLK_FULL 0.86 -> 0.90, the scout's option (a)) puts the subject on 90 pre-smoothing and 91 after it, with Moses at 88 — the same wall, the same answer — and it drags the ceiling and recal_162's graded floor with it, which this line does not. BLK_FULL 1.00, the width that would reach 88 on that channel, takes Mutombo '97 to 97 against 98 +-0. Since Moses '85 and McHale '85 differ only in drep (0.700 vs 0.850) and McHale's is the LARGER, no monotone reading of a ballot can drop the subject below the top of his tolerance while recal_133 stands.

MONOTONE AND SUBTRACTIVE BY CONSTRUCTION: the graded reputation is <= drep everywhere, it enters the same blend weight, and the season's Prot pool is built on the ungated ID above, so no card can rise. Measured: 88 cards move rimprot, none by more than 2, none up; 41 cards move DEF, none by more than 3; 19 move OVR, none by more than 3.
npm run harness: all nine tactics PASS on main's constants (hunt 3.85 / crashOff 0.32 / crashDef 0.50). No tax re-sweep was needed and src/engine/tactics.ts is untouched.
cost: THE 76ers '85 DEFDIAL IS ON A KNIFE EDGE AND A LATER ROUND SHOULD KNOW IT. recal_133's 93 +-2 reads 91 — its floor — and the five's drtg sits 0.0001 above the 91/90 rounding boundary. ANY round that lowers ANY of Cheeks '85 / Erving '85 / Bobby Jones '85 / Barkley '85 / Moses Malone '85 on any defensive bar by any amount breaks it. Moses Malone '85 rimprot 86 is effectively a pin now; it is the reason this round stopped at 91.
Kevin McHale '85 lands at the TOP of his tolerance (91 against 88 +-3, error +3), not near his number. If Tomer wants the 88 itself, recal_133 has to be re-ruled first — the two cannot both stand.

CARRIED_UNLOCK is derived from CARRIED_REIN. A later round that moves recal_160's 0.50 moves this gate too; that is deliberate (one carried-ballot doctrine, two gates) but it means the rim anchors must be re-read whenever CARRIED_REIN changes.
